value.rationale: The true spectral input governing Szegedy eigenphases in a minimal graph integrity defect is distinguished from a Rayleigh estimate cited as exact. For zero marked vertices the actual top eigenvalue does not move at all, while with any fixed number of marks the correct n^-3 coefficient is 2m, not 2m+1/2. This changes a physically motivated spectral sensitivity calibration and provides all discriminant eigenvalues for every size, not merely a routine numerical increment.
